nodes.name: Claude 3 Haiku (Bedrock)
nodes.notes: Shared by BOTH agents below — same model, one node, fanned out to two Agent nodes.

options.systemMessage: You extract two things from a loyalty-programme request: the member ID, and which channel the person wants the reply sent to. Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no other text, in exactly this shape: {"member_id": "MBR-XXX-000", "delivery_channel": "email"}. delivery_channel must be either "email" or "telegram" — treat any mention of "mail", "email", or "gmail" as "email", and any mention of "telegram" or "chat" as "telegram". If the channel isn't mentioned at all, default to "email". If no member ID is present, set member_id to an empty string.

nodes.name: Query Member — DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Same table/keys as your existing setup — points_ledger by customer_id.

options.systemMessage: You write short, friendly loyalty-programme status summaries for a member lookup. If found is false, just say the member ID wasn't found and to double-check it. Otherwise include tier, points balance, points earned, points redeemed, status, member since, and tier expiry. If delivery_channel is "email", write 2-4 short sentences plus the key facts clearly labeled, suitable for an email body. If delivery_channel is "telegram", write a much shorter, single-message version with just the headline facts. Output plain text only — no markdown, no JSON.
